programme.title: Les Super-héros : Comment ont-ils Conquis le Monde ?
programme.desc: Des comics à Hollywood, l'incroyable ascension des super-héros devenus un phénomène mondial.

programme.title: Blockbusters 80
programme.desc: "Blockbusters 80" nous replonge dans les films d'action iconiques des années 80, symboles d'une époque.

programme.title: Walt Disney, le rêveur éveillé
programme.desc: Mêlant archives et interviews, ce documentaire dévoile qui était l'homme derrière le légendaire Walt Disney.

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: Les Misérables que propose cette adaptation, si ce n'est une formule qui semble déjà tourner à vide ?

programme.title: Écran Large
programme.desc: Digger, un twist surprenant qui divise la critique. Est-ce une satire politique, une comédie catastrophe, une tragédie humaine ou les trois à la fois ? On fait le point.

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: Les moments les plus mémorables du cinéma et des célébrités sont classés dans cette émission captivante.

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: Les moments les plus mémorables du cinéma et des célébrités sont classés dans cette émission captivante.

programme.title: Basmati Blues
programme.desc: Linda, brillante scientifique américaine, est envoyée en Inde pour vendre le riz génétiquement modifié qu'elle a créé. Mais elle se rend compte qu'elle cause du tort aux fermiers qu'elle pensait aider. Lorsque l'amour s'en mêle, Linda est plus perdue que jamais.

programme.title: Hungry Hearts
programme.desc: Jude est Américain, Mina Italienne. Ils se rencontrent à New York, tombent fous amoureux et se marient. Lorsque Mina tombe enceinte, une nouvelle vie s'offre à eux. Mais l'arrivée du bébé bouleverse leur relation.

programme.title: Apartment 12
programme.desc: Un artiste de Los Angeles voit sa vie basculer lorsque son exposition d'art est annulée et que sa petite-amie mannequin le quitte.

programme.title: Ensemble à tous prix
programme.desc: Gensan et Ruby vivent en marge de la société à Los Angeles. Par une nuit fatidique, ils ratent leur chance de saisir une opportunité, ce qui déclenche une série d'événements aux conséquences désastreuses.

programme.title: I Love My Mum
programme.desc: Un duo mère-fils est expédié par inadvertance dans un conteneur de Londres au Maroc avec rien d'autre que leur pyjama. L'aventure les emmène à travers l'Espagne et la France pour rentrer chez eux et reconstruire leur relation rocailleuse.

programme.title: L'homme de ma vie et moi
programme.desc: Niki anime un podcast bien connu sur les relations amoureuses. Lorsqu'un grand éditeur la contacte pour un éventuel contrat de livre, elle se retrouve en difficulté car le podcast est basé sur sa relation avec un petit ami imaginaire, Monsieur Parfait. Elle a besoin d'un remplaçant...

programme.title: Ava
programme.desc: Ava, 13 ans, apprend qu'elle perdra la vue plus tôt que ce qu'elle espérait, et affronte le problème à sa manière.

programme.title: Killer Mom
programme.desc: Lorsque Allison, 14 ans, perd son père dans un accident d'avion, trois ans après la mort de sa mère adoptive, elle est dévastée. Lors des funérailles, elle est choquée de rencontrer sa mère biologique, Jessica. Elle et sa demi-sœur Sydni seront encore plus choquées de découvrir que Jessica a un plan infâme pour contrôler les 40 millions de dollars dont Allison doit hériter.

programme.title: Sortie Mortelle
programme.desc: Des inconnus sont piégés dans une maison où un événement terrible a eu lieu il y a 100 ans.

programme.title: Dans la Tête d'Alan Moore
programme.desc: La vie d'une légende de la BD et de la contre-culture.

programme.title: Pas de Chance
programme.desc: Archie est un escroc engagé par un propriétaire de parc d'attractions pour assassiner sa femme.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Oxygen
programme.desc: Deux gars kidnappent la femme d'un homme riche et l'enterrent dans une boîte avec 24 heures d'oxygène.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Criminals: Le Dernier Casse
programme.desc: Différentes actions menées dans la ville de Londres, contre l'environnement violent du trafic d'armes.

programme.title: Toi et moi à la montagne
programme.desc: Lorsque Rebecca, conceptrice de produits, ment en racontant des histoires lors d'un entretien d'embauche sur son leadership, son mensonge est mis à l'épreuve lors d'une retraite dans les montagnes de Tahoe. Elle y sera évaluée, ainsi que d'autres candidats, afin de déterminer leur adéquation avec la culture de l'entreprise axée sur les activités de plein air. Elle est associée à Nathan, un vendeur potentiel qui déteste la nature. Malgré leurs différences, ils devront collaborer pour réussir et pourraient bien tomber amoureux au cours de cette expérience.

programme.title: La recette de l'amour
programme.desc: Suit Lia qui peine à développer son service de livraison de repas à but non lucratif parce qu'elle insiste pour tout faire elle-même, mais avec l'aide d'Eli, elle découvre que les affaires, tout comme les romances, peuvent fleurir avec un peu d'effort et de confiance.

programme.title: La Retraite de l'Amour
programme.desc: Jenny, créatrice de contenu, participe à une retraite d'entreprise à Miami pour sauver l'image d'une marque de cosmétiques. Entre ambition et romance avec Nate, le frère de son patron, tout se complique.

programme.title: Sculpté avec amour
programme.desc: Isla, artiste timide, accepte de réaliser une sculpture pour impressionner le patron de Mark, un vendeur charmeur. Problème : elle n'a jamais sculpté. Avec l'aide de Mark, elle découvre confiance et amour.

programme.title: Amoureux pour le show
programme.desc: Tara, présentatrice télé en perte de vitesse, accepte de participer à une émission où elle doit épouser un inconnu. Mais en rencontrant Joe, son “mari idéal”, elle commence à douter que tout soit faux.

programme.title: Grown Ups
programme.desc: Des retrouvailles hilarantes ! 5 amis d'enfance originaires de la même ville se retrouvent trente ans plus tard. Ils vont réaliser combien leurs vies sont différentes et vont vite découvrir que vieillir ne signifie pas forcément grandir.

programme.title: Chair de Poule 2
programme.desc: Ne soyez pas trop curieux ! Pour préparer la brocante de l'école, deux meilleurs amis : Sonny et Sam, sont en quête de trésors qu'auraient précipitamment abandonnés les gens dans leurs ordures. Mais après avoir passé au crible la vielle maison de M. Stine, ils ouvrent un livre jusqu'à lors scellé qui libère un cauchemar surnaturel : Slappy ! Une course contre la montre s'engage alors, avec l'aide de Sarah la sœur de Sonny, ils vont tout mettre en œuvre pour tenter de ramener le Pantin maléfique et tous les monstres qu'il a ressuscité à l'intérieur du livre, avant qu'il ne répande un chaos total...

programme.title: Still Crazy
programme.desc: Wisbech 1977. Strange Fruit, le groupe de rock britannique, jette ses derniers feux. Entre les chamailleries mesquines et les coups bas en coulisses et sur scene, le groupe se dissout. Ibiza 1997. Tony, l'ancien clavier, reconverti en fournisseur de preservatifs sur l'ile, rencontre par hasard le fils du promoteur de Wisbech qui lui propose de reformer le groupe pour un concert, Wisbech 1998.

programme.title: C'est La Fin
programme.desc: Six amis se retrouvent enfermés dans une maison alors qu'une épouvantable catastrophe ravage Los Angeles. Tandis qu'à l'extérieur le monde s'effondre, à l'intérieur, le manque de provisions et l'isolement vont vite rendre la situation intenable. Contraints de s'aventurer dehors, ils vont affronter leur destin et découvrir le véritable sens de l'amitié et de la rédemption.

programme.title: Kids in America
programme.desc: Quand le principal d'un lycée abuse de son pouvoir pour restreindre la liberté d'expression à l'intérieur de l'établissement, un groupe de sept jeunes, encouragés par un professeur passionné, s'allient pour protester contre l'hypocrisie de leur administration.

programme.title: Mariage express
programme.desc: Un jeune homme déçu par la vie décide de cesser sa quête du grand amour jusqu'au jour où il rencontre une jeune serveuse désabusée ... Entre les deux, le coup de foudre est inévitable.

programme.title: Van Wilder: The Rise of Taj
programme.desc: Après avoir découvert, grâce à son légendaire mentor Van Wilder, les plaisirs les plus charnels, Taj Badalandabad (Kal Penn) part en Angleterre étudier à la prestigieuse Université de Camford.

programme.title: La machine à démonter le temps
programme.desc: Préparez-vous à botter le passé avec "La machine à démonter le temps !" Les rires délirants éclatent lorsque quatre amis partagent une nuit folle à boire dans un jacuzzi de station de ski, pour se réveiller avec une gueule de bois atroce... en 1986.

programme.title: Compilation Bonanza Épisodes 47, 48, 49
programme.desc: Les aventures de Ben Cartwright et de ses fils dans le Far West, alors qu'ils gèrent et défendent leur ranch du Nevada tout en aidant la communauté environnante.

programme.title: Demande pardon à Dieu, pas à moi...
programme.desc: Alors que Cjamango est absent de son ranch, six bandits attaquent et tuent tous les membres de sa famille. Bouleversé par cette tragédie, il entreprend de se venger.

programme.title: Le grand McLintock
programme.desc: George Washington McLintock, "GW" pour les amis comme pour les ennemis, est un baron du bétail et l'homme le plus riche du territoire.

programme.title: Django, le taciturne
programme.desc: Django arrive dans la ville de Santa Anna à la demande d'un homme nommé Sanders qui essayait d'acheter un passage sûr pour sa cargaison à un bandit mexicain nommé El Santo.

programme.title: Creuse ta fosse, j'aurai ta peau
programme.desc: Un homme est faussement accusé de vol de banque, ce qui pousse son frère à le faire sortir de prison.

programme.title: Garringo
programme.desc: Quand il était petit, Johnny a vu son père tué par des soldats. Des années plus tard, il est devenu un hors-la-loi et tue des soldats chaque fois qu'il le peut. Le lieutenant Garringo (Steffen) est envoyé pour arrêter Johnny (Lawrence) et le ramener vivant.

programme.title: Ardor
programme.desc: Un homme mystérieux surgit de la forêt tropicale argentine pour venir en aide à un pauvre fermier et à sa fille, menacés par une bande de mercenaires engagés pour les forcer à vendre leurs terres.

programme.title: Bravo Django
programme.desc: Envoyé dans le Montana pour traquer des braqueurs de banque, un chasseur de primes prend la place d'un shérif remplaçant qui n'est pas arrivé à destination et se retrouve impliqué dans une guerre territoriale entre agriculteurs et éleveurs.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississippi
programme.desc: Western européen basé sur le roman de Friedrich Gerstäcker, se déroulant au 19ème siècle dans une ville sur les rives du fleuve Mississippi. La région est en proie à une bande de pirates dirigée par le capitaine Kelly, qui vivent sur une île du fleuve, d'où ils lancent des raids sur les bateaux à vapeur et les radeaux de commerçants de passage, les dépouillant de leur cargaison et assassinant les équipages. Les habitants de la ville et les colons font de leur mieux pour mettre fin aux crimes et se débarrasser des pirates et de leur audacieux chef.

programme.title: RED SNOW
programme.desc: Une romancière vampire en difficulté doit se défendre contre de vrais vampires pendant Noël à Lake Tahoe.

programme.title: 12 Feet Deep
programme.desc: Deux sœurs (Alexandra Park et Nora-Jane Noone) sont piégées sous la protection en verre automatique d'une piscine olympique et doivent survivre dans l'eau en pleine nuit.

programme.title: Kristy
programme.desc: Justine, étudiante à l'université, travaille dur pour subvenir à ses besoins au Bryce College, où elle fait ses études. Pendant Thanksgiving, son petit ami Aaron rentre chez lui et Justine prévoit de rester sur le campus avec sa colocataire, Nicole. Mais contre toute attente, le père de Nicole l'invite à Aspen, tandis que Justine reste au dortoir. Une nuit, Justine se rend en voiture à une supérette pour acheter des provisions et rencontre Violet, qui la menace. Bouleversée, Justine retourne au campus, où elle se retrouve bientôt poursuivie par Violet et trois voyous appartenant à une secte. Justine doit se battre pour survivre.

programme.title: La Nuit des chauves-souris 2
programme.desc: L'histoire suit un groupe de soldats en mission dans une zone isolée pour capturer un scientifique fou, qui se retrouve la proie de chauves-souris carnivores génétiquement modifiées.

programme.title: Je suis vivant!
programme.desc: Un journaliste américain placé temporairement en Europe centrale recherche sa nouvelle petite amie, qui a soudainement disparu.

programme.title: Enlèvement
programme.desc: À la recherche d'une femme disparue dans le Dakota du Nord, un agent du FBI et un shérif se concentrent sur son mari, un fanatique religieux, mais découvrent quelque chose de bien plus sinistre.

programme.title: L'arrivée
programme.desc: Le radio-astronome Zane Zaminsky (Charlie Sheen) croit avoir capté un bruit cosmique qui signale l'intelligence extraterrestre. Sa recherche désespérée de réponses l'amène au Mexique à une centrale nucléaire mystérieuse, où il est arrêté pour le meurtre d'un scientifique.

programme.title: Les derniers citoyens
programme.desc: Dans un monde postapocalyptique gangréné par des gangs sanguinaires, Nina (Kate Bosworth) et Mark (Tyler Hoechlin) arpentent des contrées sans foi ni loi pour trouver un refuge et, à bout de souffle, doivent rester solidaires pour survivre.

programme.title: Cyborg X
programme.desc: Après que X-Corp, un fabricant d'armes radical, ait été envahi par un cybervirus, un groupe de survivants doit se battre pour sauver l'humanité de l'armée de machines que le virus contrôle désormais.

programme.title: Kings Glaive: Final Fantasy XV
programme.desc: Nyx Ulric et les Kingsglaive défendent Insomnia contre l'empire de Niflheim, qui convoite le cristal de Lucis.

programme.title: Robocop: L'amendement 22
programme.desc: Quand Nancy Murphy est arrêtée lors d'une manifestation, Robocop doit choisir entre maintenir l'ordre et protéger sa famille.

programme.title: Farscape: L'Odieuse Vérité
programme.desc: Crais et Talyn retrouvent Moya, mais un incident conduit l'équipage devant un procès pour destruction de vaisseau.

programme.title: Invasion Planète Terre: Les Volontaires
programme.desc: La Résistance infiltre un programme Taelon pour jeunes après avoir capturé une volontaire susceptible de livrer des informations.

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: La présidente doit choisir entre sauver son frère, pilote d'un avion détourné, ou protéger la population.

programme.title: Les Prédateurs: Obsession
programme.desc: Un professeur repousse les avances d'une étudiante, mais découvre que l'obsession de celle-ci ne s'arrêtera peut-être pas à la mort.

programme.title: La Marque du Dragon
programme.desc: Pour la justice, un jeune garde forestier utilise ses compétences en arts martiaux pour affronter son père et ses frères, et devient un véritable héros.

programme.title: Vikingdom : L'Eclipse de Sang
programme.desc: Eirick combattra de l'enfer et de l'au-delà afin de récupérer un artéfact mythique.

programme.title: L'Exorcisme de Tamara
programme.desc: Un cambriolage tourne à l'horreur dans une maison.

programme.title: Le Pacte Du Mal
programme.desc: Diego, médecin endurci face à la douleur, est tenu pour responsable après la tentative de suicide de sa patiente Sara.

programme.title: The Lion Woman
programme.desc: Née couverte de poils, Eva Arctander lutte contre le rejet et transforme sa différence en force.

programme.title: Methgator
programme.desc: La police avait prévenu les habitants de ne pas jeter de la méthamphétamine dans les toilettes afin d'éviter que les alligators en mangent. À Sweet Water Point, en Floride, ils n'ont pas écouté.

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: En vacances à la montagne, Charlie et ses amis profitent d'un séjour paisible, sans savoir que des OVNI apparaissent et que des extraterrestres enlèvent des humains à travers le monde.

programme.title: L'ENFER DES LOUPS
programme.desc: En 1850, des meurtres terrifient un village. Un marchand itinérant, Manuel Romasanta, cache un sombre secret lié à la légende du loup-garou.

programme.title: Prospect : L'Ambre de la Lune Verte
programme.desc: Cee et son père voyagent dans l'espace pour trouver des pierres précieuses.

programme.title: Irène
programme.desc: Une Parisienne espère l'amour d'un directeur, mais découvre son mensonge et tombe amoureuse d'un peintre

programme.title: Coup de foudre à l'italienne
programme.desc: À Boston, deux non-Italiens se font passer pour des Italiens afin de se séduire.

programme.title: Eichmann
programme.desc: Eichmann avoue à Less son rôle d'architecte de la Solution finale lors de sa dernière confession.

programme.title: Le Caïman
programme.desc: Bruno Bonomo, producteur en crise, retrouve dignité et espoir grâce à un film sur Berlusconi.

programme.title: OVNI: Sur la piste extraterrestre
programme.desc: Derek (Alex Sharp), un étudiant d'université brillant hanté par la vue d'un OVNI durant son enfance, croit que les mystérieuses observations signalées dans de nombreux aéroports des États-Unis sont des OVNIS...

programme.title: Le prix du secret
programme.desc: Le prix du secret est une histoire de trahison familiale, de perte d'amour et d'un sombre secret affectant une puissante famille politique du Sud profond. Kate découvre le passé de Logan, révélant des secrets de famille et la mettant en danger.

programme.title: Minamata
programme.desc: Le photographe de guerre W. Eugene Smith retourne au Japon où il documente l'effet dévastateur de l'empoisonnement au mercure dans les communautés côtières.

programme.title: Le combat final
programme.desc: Anthony Rodriguez, un jeune homme mi-italien mi-portoricain, est initié à la boxe par un ténor de la mafia quand sa mère meurt et que son père violent et alcoolique est chassé de la ville.

programme.title: La Place du mort
programme.desc: Un chauffeur doit conduire un complice vers une embuscade mortelle. Sa conscience vacille.

programme.title: La Chambre des morts
programme.desc: Deux techniciens découvrent 2 millions d'euros à côté d'un cadavre dans un champ d'éoliennes.

programme.title: Mafia Inc
programme.desc: Les Gamache habillent la famille mafieuse Paternò. Vince veut faire ses preuves auprès du parrain…

programme.title: Under Siege
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un agent de la CIA renégat et ses mercenaires s'emparent d'un cuirassé américain pour récupérer ses ogives nucléaires, la seule personne à bord qui puisse sauver la mise est le chef cuisinier, qui se trouve être un ancien Navy SEAL.

programme.title: Escape from Mogadishu
programme.desc: Au cœur de la guerre civile somalienne, les diplomates des deux Corées s'allient pour fuir Mogadiscio.

programme.title: Surrounded
programme.desc: À la recherche d'une mine d'or, l'ex-soldate Mo Washington va dans l'Ouest. Une embuscade la force à capturer un bandit. Une lutte dans la nature sauvage s'ensuit. Réalisé par Anthony Mandler, avec Letitia Wright, Jamie Bell et Michael K. Williams.

programme.title: Code Ennemi
programme.desc: Emerson est un agent du FBI relegué à un poste sans grande importance après avoir refusé de suivre des ordres pendant une mission. Il doit se charger à présent de protéger Katherine ...

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Un ancien criminel protège une jeune fille qui lui rappelle son enfant. Quand elle est menacée, il replonge dans la violence.

programme.title: Escadron 303
programme.desc: Pendant la bataille d'Angleterre, les pilotes polonais de l'escadron 303 affrontent la Luftwaffe avec courage, esprit de revanche et une détermination qui fera d'eux une unité redoutable.

programme.title: Sky Hunter
programme.desc: De jeunes pilotes fraîchement diplômés intègrent une unité militaire d'élite où ils doivent prouver leur valeur en mission.

programme.title: Gotti
programme.desc: John Gotti bâtit un empire mafieux à New York tout en tentant de préserver son fils, entre loyauté familiale, pouvoir et chute annoncée.

programme.title: Your Monster
programme.desc: Jeune actrice de comédie musicale, Laura se désespère de sa situation : elle sort d'une opération liée à son cancer, doit retourner vivre dans la maison de son enfance, et son compagnon Jacob vient de la quitter. Sa vie bascule encore davantage lorsqu'elle découvre qu'un monstre vit désormais chez elle.

programme.title: Watch Out
programme.desc: Dans un quartier résidentiel calme, la jeune Ashley est loin de se douter de ce qui l'attend quand un cambriolage transforme sa nuit de baby-sitting en un véritable cauchemar de Noël.

programme.title: Vampires en Toute Intimité
programme.desc: En Nouvelle-Zélande, une équipe s'installe dans la demeure de vampires afin de tourner un documentaire sur leur mode de vie. Les créatures tentent de sortir dans les bars, pensent nettoyer le sang après leurs méfaits, cherchent un style vestimentaire et découvrent Google. Elles doivent également faire face à un nouveau venu de leur espèce, très peu discret.

programme.title: Tucker & Dale Fightent le Mal
programme.desc: Tucker et Dale sont deux bouseux au grand cœur partis se ressourcer en pleine forêt. Mais leur route croise celle de jeunes étudiants fêtards qui, à la suite d'un quiproquo entraînant la mort de l'un d'entre eux, prennent Tucker et Dale pour des tueurs psychopathes et décident de leur faire la peau...

programme.title: You Might Be the Killer
programme.desc: Un animateur de colonie de vacances souffrant de trous de mémoire se retrouve entouré de victimes de meurtre. Il se tourne vers son amie passionnée de films d'horreur pour lui demander conseil et faire face au fait qu'il est peut-être le tueur.

programme.title: Hard Rush
programme.desc: L'agent Maxwell travaille sur une opération internationale de trafic de drogues à Los Angeles.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: Un groupe d'étudiants se rend dans la forêt tropicale à la recherche de dessins rupestres. Mais un boa constricteur de quinze mètres que l'on croyait éteint a faim de sang.

programme.title: Boston Streets
programme.desc: Deux amis d'enfance du sud de Boston se tournent vers le crime pour s'en sortir.

programme.title: Jamesy Boy
programme.desc: Un jeune délinquant incarcéré dans une prison de haute sécurité se lie d'amitié avec un meurtrier qui devient son mentor.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: Né dans les flammes de l'enfer, le démon Hellboy est transporté sur Terre lors d'une sombre cérémonie célébrée par les nazis, désireux d'utiliser les forces infernales à des fins de conquête. Sauvé par le docteur Broom, Hellboy est alors élevé pour combattre les forces du Mal.

programme.title: The Punisher
programme.desc: Ancien membre de la Delta Force, puis agent spécial au FBI, Frank Castle s'apprête à se retirer pour mener une existence paisible auprès de sa femme et de son jeune fils. Lors de son ultime mission, les choses tournent mal et le fils de Howard Saint, puissant businessman et magnat de la pègre, est tué. Ivre de vengeance, Saint organise le massacre de Frank et de toute sa famille.

programme.title: Tigre Et Dragon
programme.desc: Élu "Meilleur Film de l'année" par plus de 100 critiques américains ! Deux maîtres guerriers (Chow Yun Fat et Michelle Yeoh) affrontent leur plus grande épreuve suite au vol de l'épée de la Destinée. Une jeune aristocrate (Zhang Ziyi) se prépare à un mariage arrangé et révèle ses incroyables talents de combat et son passé romantique. Bien que tous les guerriers luttent pour la justice, ils affrontent leurs pires ennemis et le pouvoir inévitable et puissant de l'amour. Avec des paysages somptueux de la Chine du 19ème siècle, CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON est un blockbuster plein d'action du réalisateur acclamé Ang Lee (Sense and Sensibility, The Ice Storm) qui offre d'impressionnantes chorégraphies d'arts martiaux de Yuen Wo Ping (Matrix).

programme.title: Lake Placid : Héritage
programme.desc: De jeunes explorateurs s'aventurent sur un mystérieux lac retiré des cartes modernes, en quêtes de secrets à explorer. Ils y découvrent une île dans laquelle se trouve un laboratoire abandonné, mais s'aperçoivent qu'elle abrite quelque chose de terrifiant : un prédateur des plus mortel. Avant même qu'ils n'aient temps de faire demi-tour, nos aventuriers sont pris au piège. Ils vont rapidement devoir mettre leur rivalité de côté pour réagir ensemble, s'ils veulent avoir la moindre chance de rester en vie…

programme.title: La Légende des super-héros
programme.desc: Le docteur Rockus crée des héros avec un badge. Plus tard, ils veulent récupérer leur pouvoir…

programme.desc: Le soleil menace d'enflammer l'atmosphère : une course contre la montre mondiale débute.

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: Louise Redknapp On Coping With Loneliness And Low Self-Esteem
programme.desc: Singer Louise Redknapp discusses feeling pressure to be the 'good girl' after years in a 90s girlband and marriage to a sports star, which left her afraid of saying or doing the wrong thing. She explores how not knowing her dad and becoming a mother have impacted her confidence and identity, and shares how she's learning to trust her own gut instinct and embrace different facets of her character.

programme.title: Kate Winslet: Why I'm Embracing Wrinkles And Championing Women

In this chat, Fearne and Kate share their own experiences of both grieving and co-parenting at Christmas. Regularly labelled as "fat" by the media, Kate explains what effect that scrutiny had on her self-esteem, and why it's made her even more passionate about setting an example to younger women by ageing naturally.

programme.title: Jesy Nelson On Finding Herself And Feeling Free After Leaving Little Mix

programme.title: Brian Cox On Finding Purpose In A Vast Universe
programme.desc: What can the universe teach us about being human? Physicist Professor Brian Cox discusses getting comfortable with being wrong, the difference between having an argument and making an argument, and how curiosity and doubt are essential to learning and happiness. He explores why ego blocks human progress, how democracy depends on doubt, the beauty of curiosity, the randomness of life, and our greatest moral responsibility in protecting the planet.

programme.title: Leah Williamson On Bouncing Back From A Footballer's Worst Nightmare

Coleen also discusses school gate WhatsApp group dynamics, dealing with stress, and what it was like being thrust into the public eye as a teenager when her boyfriend became a footballer.

The heartbreaking and ardent love of Lee Sam-jae, Seo-young's father, for his daughter is depicted in this weekend drama, highlighting the preciousness of parental love. It teaches us that family is interconnected not only by blood but also by love."

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.8
programme.desc: Samjae continues to work hard as a hall manager to save money and face but ends up at the police station much to Seoyeong's disappointment. Hojeong gets busted for being in love which will lead to dire consequences for her. Seongjae finds out what's been going on with his brother and his tutor and why she has to quit. He relieves his stress the only way he knows how... Which is to go on a shopping spree... Just like his mother. Migyeong finds out the truth behind her boyfriend and Ujae gives up on Seoyeong in the end.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.9
programme.desc: Ujae's mother goes on a hunger strike to try and prevent Ujae's marriage but in the end she strikes a deal that forces Seoyeong to back away. Ujae's at his wits end because he's done everything he can to win Seoyeong's heart. He knows she loves him and her pride and fear are keeping her away. In the end he decides that he can't do anything for her and leaves for the U.S. Meanwhile Hojeong tried desperately to meet Sangu one last time to return his handkerchief only to discover that his father's sick. She ends up nursing him and gets to see Sangu who confirms that he doesn't like her but doesn't hate her either. This is good enough for her.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.10
programme.desc: Seoyeong is determined to maintain her lie about going overseas. There is no way she can confess to Ujae that she lied about her father. Sangu is distraught at her decision but can't help her out. There is no way that he can disown his father no matter how much he has hated him too. In the midst of this Hojeong agrees to go to the U.S. with the promise that after she returns she can do whatever she wants. In the end Samjae goes to be a pretend guest at a VIP's wedding... The twist is shocking!

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.11
programme.desc: It's been 3 years since the last episode... Jiseon has a hard time adjusting to her perfect daughter-in-law... What every other mother-in-law would be happy about, she finds a burden and complains to Gapsun. Meanwhile Hojeong returns from the U.S., bringing back a man with her that she's sure her mother will accept. Migyeong is now dating Sangu and considering marriage whilst Seoyeong has to handle a major case and continues to grow weary of being a judge. Samjae is the one who is truly doing well with himself, having paid of his debts and worked hard to become a decent father. Perhaps he hopes for the day he'll be reunited with his daughter.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.12
programme.desc: Marriage troubles continue between Ujae's parents as their wedding anniversary comes by. Seoyeong gets scouted by Unique Law Firm after the sentencing of her murder trial. She finds it harder by the day to work as a judge. Meanwhile Samjae is continuing to work hard and Sangu's love for Migyeong is deepening. She's worried about telling him the truth whilst Hojeong does what she can to gain some independence from her overly attached mother.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.4
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

Do they live up to their reputations, and who really is the most dangerous? From killer crocs to ferocious big cats, we'll run you through the most dangerous teeth, fangs, stingers and bites in the animal kingdom. These are the deadliest animals on planet earth.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life's element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.desc: Where in Europe are bisons still to be found in the wild? And where do probably more migratory birds breed than in any other European country? The flora and fauna of Poland are full of surprises: the South is dominated by the 2000m peaks of the Tatra, to the North-East the Biebrza river forms one of the largest swamp regions of Europe, a paradise for rare birds like the ruff. Masuria is the breeding-ground for thousands of white storks, more than anywhere else on Earth. The much shier and rarer black stork also finds refuge in the large expanses of forest that stretch to the Baltic Sea. In winter, an icy wind sweeps Eastern Poland and only those with a thick skin survive in the region bordering Belorus. The cold doesn't bother the bison. Thick coats protect these ancient cattle against the snow and icy wind, but lack of food in winter does present a problem. The bison here are among the last of their kind. Once upon a time, huge herds roamed most of the European continent, today the only bison in Central Europe living in the wild are located in Eastern Poland. Poland's hard winters are no problem for otter and beaver, whose extremely dense coats protect them against the cold and enable them to swim and dive in the icy water. Although both animals are water-dwellers, they're not rivals: beavers are vegetarians and in winter eat stores of leaves and bark. Otters are active hunters all year round and live on fish and crabs. As soon as spring arrives in Poland, the river Biebrza becomes a hive of activity: thousands of birds vie with each other to be heard as they use the vast area of swampland to rest and breed. White-winged black terns and black-necked grebes build their nests, then the mating season begins for the ruffs, with the males strutting their stuff for potential mates.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers. With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL

Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR

Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

Upon discovering a ledger detailing Gangcheon's bribes, Jeongi resolves to win Royal Consort Inbin's favor. Meanwhile, Hwa-ryeong decides to eliminate Son Haengsu.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.25
programme.desc: Leaving her audience with Inbin, Jeongi runs into Gangcheon and Yukdo at the palace. When King Seonjo refers to Euldam as a traitor, Jeongi is left on edge. Together with Taedo, she devises a plan to ensnare Gangcheon. Later, Gwanghae returns the bowl Jeongi once gave to Son Haengsu. Impressed by Jeongi's skill, Inbin requests that if Jeongi crafts a medicine bowl that fully satisfies Prince Shinseong, she be officially appointed a master potter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.26
programme.desc: As Jeongi and Yukdo face off in a decisive competition, all eyes at the Bunwon are fixed on the outcome. Thrilled at the prospect of becoming nangcheong, Yukdo is confident of victory. Jeongi asks Hwa-ryeong to procure the white clay needed for the contest, while Hwa-ryeong urges Yukdo to defeat Jeongi at all costs. When the medicine bowls are completed, Jeongi and Yukdo anxiously await Prince Shinseong's judgment—until the prince suddenly collapses after drinking from the bowl.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.27
programme.desc: Jeongi confronts Gangcheon, demanding that he reveal the truth about Euldam, but his shameless willingness to offer a false confession only fuels her anger. Gwanghae vows before King Seonjo to uncover not only the truth behind the current 사건 but also the events of the previous nangcheong competition. A royal order is issued for Yukdo's execution, and a grief-stricken Gangcheon kneels before the palace gates in penitence.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.28
programme.desc: Mun Saseung is appointed as the new nangcheong of the Bunwon, and Jeongi becomes the first female master potter in Joseon history. Seeing Jeongi clad in her official potter's robes, Gwanghae smiles with pride and gifts her the workshop once used by Euldam. Reduced to desperation, Gangcheon and Yukdo beg Mun Saseung to allow them to remain at the Bunwon. Elsewhere, at the request of a Japanese merchant, Hwa-ryeong summons Jeongi—hinting at new trials yet to come.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Meaningful Stone! Since releasing her debut single Camera in My Dreams in July 2017 she has garnered much attention with her self-produced music videos and live performance videos on YouTube. Naturally she became one of the most aspiring indie musicians in the Korean music scene who was also highly praised by renowned music critic and writer Bae Soon-tak. This past September Meaningful Stone released her first full-length album a call from my dreams which is named after the lead single off the album. As the title implies the song is about a call she received in her dreams when she was struggling with life's ups and downs. As opposed to reality she was continuously speaking words of love to herself while dreaming. She shares that hopeful message with listeners to offer a moment of comfort. In this episode Meaningful Stone performs a call from my dream nameless treasure hunt if I grow up as if and beep-boop-beep-boop. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and check out her unpredictable yet genuine musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is guitarist and singer-songwriter Jukjae! This artist initially made his reputation in the music scene as a session guitarist composer and arranger. Then in April 2014 he released a self-written song View through the compilation album bright #2 and his debut album One Word in November officially starting a singing career of his own. Thanks to his dexterity in playing guitar he has played with a number of top musicians including Park Hyo-shin Kim Dong-ryul IU and more. Last month in November Jukjae released his second mini-album 2006 the year Jukjae describes as “the most beautiful and innocent time” in his life. With the lead single Shining My 2006 he hopes people will look back at the time they were at their brightest and happiest to escape reality for a brief moment. In this episode Jukjae performs Shining My 2006 The Door Do You Want To Walk With Me? Let's Go See the Stars and View. Tune in to I'm LIVE and take a glimpse into his artistry!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the talented vocalist duo GB9! GB9 is composed of Gil-gu and Bong-gu who were known for their exceptional singing skills even before their debut. They sang for a number of top-notch artists as backup vocalists including Lee Juck Park Hyo-shin Kim Jo-han Taeyang Baek Z Young Gummy Lynn Kim Tae-woo and more. The two are also top vocal coaches who taught B1A4 BTOB and Oh My Girl. In 2013 the two made their official debut with the single Going Crazy and instantly captured listeners' hearts. In 2017 the duo's 2014 single I hope it's a breeze made it to the Melon Top 100 Chart and once again proved that the song is a timeless classic. From The King of Mask Singer to Immortal Songs: Singing the Legend the two took part in various music shows and impressed viewers with their artistry. Last month in November GB9 released an emotional ballad called If I knew touching listeners once more in this cold season. In this episode GB9 performs their latest single If I knew and biggest hit I hope it's a breeze among others. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy their flawless performance!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Ha Hyun-sang! This artist made his big debut in February 2018 with the single Dawn. Since then he has released two mini-albums and a number of singles and also taken part in the soundtracks of top TV series such as Mr. Sunshine Melo Is My Nature A Piece of Your Mind and Soul Mechanic. Last year he participated in a talent show for indie musicians Super Band as a member of Hoppipolla and managed to finish first. Last month Ha Hyun-sang released his new single 3108 which is about a guy wanting to go back in time to correct his past mistakes. Full of heartrending sentiments this song is more than good enough to get a glimpse into his fantastic artistry. In this episode Ha Hyun-sang performs 3108 Nostalgia A Book of Love and more to show off his talents. Tune in to I'm LIVE and let this artist melt your heart!

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Un principe per Natale

programme.title: Natale a 4 zampe
